card.name: Linking words inside organization and title names
card.fires_on: A small linking word like for, of, or Research inside a proper name of an organization, journal, or report, often after Global or Geophysical. It also fires on a few odd spots such as older before version.

modes.label: Global organization names
modes.description: The word for after Global plus a noun in names of health bodies or strategies.
modes.example: Global Alliance<< for>> Vaccines and Immunization

modes.label: Journal titles
modes.description: The word Research inside the journal name Geophysical Research Letters or Abstracts.

modes.label: Other stray spots
modes.description: Occasional single words in odd places, such as older in a note about a website version.
modes.example: originally published on an<< older>> version of The Learning Network

card.plain: It marks a small joining word in the middle of a formal name, like Global Alliance for Vaccines.
